steps: Cross the fix and turn right to the outbound heading 180°, then fly the pattern.

Cross the fix and turn to the outbound heading 180° on the non-holding side for 1 minute. Then turn left toward the holding side through more than 180° and intercept the inbound course 000° or return to the fix.
Cross the fix and fly heading 150° (30° into the holding side) for 1 minute. Then turn right to intercept the inbound course 000°.

Cross the fix and turn to the outbound heading 270° on the non-holding side for 1 minute. Then turn left toward the holding side through more than 180° and intercept the inbound course 090° or return to the fix.
Cross the fix and fly heading 330° (30° into the holding side) for 1 minute. Then turn right to intercept the inbound course 180°.

Cross the fix and turn to the outbound heading 000° on the non-holding side for 1 minute. Then turn left toward the holding side through more than 180° and intercept the inbound course 180° or return to the fix.
